summary: Round 44 recheck, 17:14-17:40Z 29 Sep (20:14-20:40 MSK). 0 Kaggle calls, no browser; nothing was built, pushed or submitted. exp89t 56669888 was still PENDING at the 17:15:03Z header (L > 8.24 h). The lens is saturated: every item in v3 (i) and the v2 table already has a recheck. So I picked three RESULTS.md rows that had 0 recheck hits and that new facts could touch. (A) B31 'duplicate-node clustering cannot change a graph', which assumed 3 um NMS keeps every node >= 3 um apart. NEW MEASUREMENT on the dummy CSVs: that premise is false for final outputs. x138 verbatim already has 58 nodes whose same-frame neighbour is < 3 um. CI (coordinject) pulls about 50 more pairs together by snapping two nodes to one refined detection: exp87a has 67 pairs < 2 um vs 17 in exp85a, 43 of them on 6bba_05db0fb1. The VERDICT still stands, though. A dummy-lab hybrid that reverts those converged nodes scores exactly the same as exp87a on all 4 clips, so the pairs sit on unannotated cells. CI's dummy-lab loss (TP -4, FP +8 on the 6bba clips, R28-RC-C) comes from single moves of annotated nodes, not from convergence. The CI private prior and the pair П3 {exp87a, #37} do not change. (B) exp03B's '+0.0048 = real gain' was judged too strongly: the gap between the two seeds (0.0073, exp16) is larger than the gain. The LB later flipped sign across stacks (+0.004, -0.003, -0.003). No final carries those weights. The lesson backs decision B: a single-source gain of 0.001 on one embryo is not private evidence. (C) exp09/divset36 'division-rich 44b6-type clips are the hard ones' is UPHELD. It adds a caveat to every dummy-lab sign: the 44b6 dummy clips carry only 46-49 TP edges each, so the K-base dummy-lab reads are in effect 6bba reads. No finding gives a build, a dummy, a slot use or a pair change. The evening chain stays as logged: the exp89t read under decision B, the 18:37Z card, T7 ~19:15Z, manual-admit at 19:44:45Z, the 19:43Z and 21:05Z SELECTED checks, and 00:07Z.

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION: RESULTS 'local Friend C / B31 duplicate-node clustering Step 1' (all 199 raw graphs): raw same-frame nearest neighbour < 1/2/3 um = 0/0/0. CLOSED because 'public 3 um NMS already excludes every pair inside the proposed radii 0.5-2.0 um, so clustering cannot change a graph'. The Friend B NMS sweep adds that kernels 3.0-5.5 um give bit-identical graphs and 6.0 um costs -0.026. WHAT CHANGED: x138 adds post-NMS stages (readmit, gapfill, linefit), and CI moves 91.5% of node rows toward the nearest refined detection of the same frame (ALPHA 0.5, MAX_UM 3.0). This is a many-to-one rule: two nodes can snap toward one target. NEW MEASUREMENT (dummy CSVs, same-frame NN, scale z/y/x 1.625/0.40625/0.40625 um). Nodes with a neighbour < 1/2/3 um: exp56 x138 2/18/58; exp70g and #37 (exp58) 4/26/82; exp85a (K) 6/34/100; exp87a (K+CI) 24/134/210; exp79a and exp75 (CI) 20/124/192. In exp87a, 67 pairs are < 2 um. Of these, 52 were >= 2 um apart before CI (41 were >= 3 um; pre-CI median 3.37 um, q90 5.03 um). Both nodes of every pair are in tracks. By clip: 6bba_05db0fb1 43, 44b6_0b24845f 18, 44b6_0113de3b 4, 6bba_05b6850b 2. So the B31 premise is FALSE for final x138/CI outputs. DOES IT MATTER? Dummy lab (overlap_lab.eval_clip on the 4 train clips): exp85a -> exp87a gives 6bba_05b6 TP 836 -> 834, FP 8 -> 11; 6bba_05db TP 1118 -> 1116, FP 88 -> 93; 44b6 unchanged (= R28-RC-C). A hybrid of exp87a with the converged nodes reverted to exp85a coordinates (104 nodes at a 2 um cutoff, 134 at 3 um) scores IDENTICALLY to exp87a on all 4 clips. NEW VERDICT: the REASON was wrong on x138 outputs and the VERDICT is UPHELD. The converged pairs are on unannotated cells, so a merge or un-snap step would be invisible on this sample (<= ~0.0003 even if every pair cost one evaluable edge). CI's dummy-lab loss comes from single moves of annotated nodes, so R28-RC-C's CI private prior (P(>=0) ~0.55-0.65, central ~+0.0002) is unchanged. П3 {exp87a (CI), #37 (no CI)} already hedges the CI sign.

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION: RESULTS exp03 B, '+0.0048 vs A; B never saw the holdout while A did => real gain'. The same table has exp16 (seed 7, same recipe) at 0.9502 vs exp03B (seed 42) at 0.9575, 'seed variance ±0.005'. exp17 (600 it, 0.9556) was called 'within noise' and exp08 (full epoch, 0.9539) 'worse'. This was never rechecked. WHAT CHANGED: the finals question now turns on gains of 0.001-0.002 on one public embryo (exp89t vs exp87a under decision B; cap 6, K, CI, DIS in the private-risk audit). NEW VERDICT: the old conclusion was JUDGED TOO STRONGLY. exp03B was the better of two seeds, and the seed-to-seed gap (0.0073) is larger than the claimed gain (0.0048). Its LB record later flipped with the stack: probe 2 +0.004 in the 0.941 pipeline, probes 11 and 15 -0.003 on the TTA stack, probe 13 -0.007 as a secondary. No final carries it: exp87a and #37 load pilkwang's detector plus the v1284 head, and biohub-ft-weights supplies only the DaughterNet insertion weights. What carries over is the scale: a single-source change below ~0.005 in a lab, or ~0.001-0.003 on one LB embryo, has flipped sign across contexts in our own record. That backs decision B (a 0.959 exp89t keeps exp87a) and the audit's caution on public-only levers. UPHELD: decision B, П3.

findings.what: OLD CONCLUSION: RESULTS exp09 (divset36, 36 division-rich videos, 92 GT divisions, 32 of them on 6bba): raw 0.8997 vs hold12 0.9575, 'division-rich videos are much harder'. The exp03 A per-video notes and the Friend B calibration row agree: 44b6 videos are the dense, weak ones where linking errors live (edge J 0.79-0.92). This was never rechecked. WHAT CHANGED: since 26 Sep the K-base knob signs have been read on a 4-clip dummy lab (SEC -0.0008..-0.0020, CI -0.0051, DIS +0.0009). The private test is ~71% other embryos. NEW VERDICT: UPHELD, with a caveat on how dummy-lab signs are read. The two 44b6 dummy clips carry only 46-49 TP edges each (this round's run: 44b6_0113 TP 46, 44b6_0b24 TP 49) vs 834-1118 on the two 6bba clips. So every K-base dummy-lab sign so far (SEC, CI, DIS) is in effect a 6bba-only read, and says nothing about the dense 44b6-like case that divset36 flags as the hard one. This does not change any decision: the dummy-lab signs were already weighted as 'not independent private evidence' (R38-RC-A, R36-RC-A), and the pair already mixes a CI file with a non-CI file.
